title: B300 single-grid c95 once published a route location outside its tile expert
observation: With the frozen mixed route, K=4, c=95 and steal budget 46920, two warmups completed but the first CUPTI/L2-flushed sample returned status 1018. Status 18 is the gather invariant that route_location[key] must lie in the tile's declared expert range. The broker released all four GPUs; there is no accepted output or timing for this arm. The same source's c=8 through c=74 arms completed in the job and passed the post-lease oracle and activity audit. The failure's key, event and slot were not retained by the f7 ABI, so its cause is unknown. Successor c4c79545 added failure-only context and passed real NVCC, 15 related contracts and the 179-case Corpus Gate. One isolated c=95 run and a separate run of two warmups plus 20 CUPTI samples on c4c79545 completed with zero oracle failures and exact tile counts; they did not reproduce status 18. This does not prove the old failure fixed or identify its frequency.
proposed_change: Use the successor's retained key, event, slot and expected expert on a bounded reproduction to distinguish a stale route_location from a wrong tile key. Inspect the exact system-scope publication and source-wave snapshot handoff before changing admission. If a mechanism is found, repair its B300 emission and matching legality analysis in a further clean Compiler commit, exercise the failing control plus counterexamples on device, and keep the Workload, FP64 oracle and CUPTI reset contract fixed. Do not silently narrow the declared c=1..95 domain or promote a general scheduling rule from the six passing controls.
